conflict: Promised 4a (direct formData is documented and the guide says the same code runs on every platform) against Promised 4b, since the rejection is Bun's own Request.formData, which Hono calls unchanged.
reason: Direct HonoRequest.formData hands the request to the platform, and Bun's own native formData rejects the mixed-case header, so the fault is the runtime's, not Hono's.
The guide says force:true always prettifies JSON responses, and a response whose Content-Type is Application/JSON stays compact on both runtimes.
